errors.evidence: In the 'NUMBER OF ENTERPRISES' chart, Industry accounts for 61% (19.0 million), Construction for 8% (2.4 million), Trade for 19% (5.9 million), and Other Services for 12% (3.7 million). The description incorrectly swaps the values for Industry and Other Services.

errors.evidence: In the 'TURNOVER' chart, Other Services has 33% (10.6 trillion), Industry 31% (9.8 trillion), Trade 31% (9.9 trillion), and Construction 6% (1.9 trillion). The description incorrectly swaps the values for Industry and Other Services.
